description: Jan-Dec mean cycle per ENSO phase. monthly_mean lists are Jan..Dec; el_nino_vs_la_nina gives El Niño minus La Niña and Welch t-test p-values per calendar month.

enso.definition: Each month takes the phase of its June-May season; years are season start years (1997 = Jun 1997-May 1998). ONI lists from ggweather.com.
